## Open questions for the reviewer

---

### Reviewer checklist (human)
- [ ] `check` CI passes
- [ ] Bottom line is supported by the evidence sections, and confidence grades seem right
- [ ] Spot-checked at least 3 decisive citations myself (opened the source, finding is at the locator, fairly represented)
- [ ] Corroboration: each rule has ≥2 independent authorities, ≥1 not US federal, or says why not
- [ ] No dose advice; medication facts trace to labels or Tier 1 guidelines
- [ ] Preference-neutral; no brand promotion
- [ ] Readable by a non-scientist; terms defined; absolute numbers given
- [ ] Adjacent-cohort cautions make sense; nothing unsafe for an out-of-scope reader without a warning
- [ ] No personal data anywhere in the diff or this description
- [ ] Rule changes (if any) are listed above with old → new → why
